concept: Denji / Chainsaw Man: a scrappy devil hunter who pulls the cord in his chest to become a chainsaw-headed devil with blades bursting from both forearms. Human-form brawling for light attacks, revving chainsaw slashes for strong attacks, a lunging grinder dash, a spinning blade whirl as the finisher. Effects: blood sprays, sparks, motion streaks.

palette.note: colours are used by `draft` (brightness-matched recolour) and as the target palette; build derives the final ≤15-colour palette from the art

moves.0x05C100: idle: hunched, chainsaw arms lowered, engine idling (blades jitter on alternate frames)
moves.0x05C101: walk: heavy stomping walk, arm blades trailing

notes: Example only. `scaffold` writes the real move list for the chosen template.
